card.name: Dose units awaiting a frequency word
card.fires_on: Words in dosing text right where a time-frequency word is expected next, such as the 2 in mg/m2, 'dose' in a dose table header, 'a' in 'dollars a year', or 'mg' before 'daily'.

modes.label: Body-surface units
modes.description: The 2 in mg/m2 or g/m2 dosing, where '/day' or 'twice daily' follows.
modes.example: Recommended XALKORI Dosage to Achieve 280 mg/m <<2>> Twice Daily

modes.label: Dose table headers
modes.description: The word dose or dosage inside table headings, just before the amount per time period.

modes.label: Amount before a period
modes.description: Words like a, per or mg that lead into a time period such as year or day.
modes.example: save you thousands of dollars<< a>> year, but it can save your life

card.writes: It pushes up words for recurring periods like annual, monthly, weekly and their Chinese equivalents.
card.plain: It fires when a dose or amount is written and the next word is likely a time period such as daily or per year.
